answer: Every epoch a verifier called PulseQuorum draws a random twentieth of the member set from the beacon and demands a fresh liveness task inside ninety seconds, so one person cannot hold many seats. The penalty trigger is a missed window: the seat forfeits its forty POA bond and rejoins the queue. Each fake needs a forty five dollar security key, a bond and ten paid operator minutes per window, so N fakes cost N times eighty eight dollars plus N hours, and a haven of parked wallets becomes a liability. Seen through that prism, the pulse of the network is what a farm cannot fake at scale.
